uncovered.sentence: Christian tradition has long heard the whole of this archangel's mission summed up in that very name, in just four words.
Scripture describes him as one of the chief princes who alone stands with him against the opposition (Daniel 10:13).

Later in the same book, at the close of a vision concerning the last days, Daniel is told plainly: at that time shall Michael rise up, the great prince, who standeth for the children of thy people (Daniel 12:1).
The ancient serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, is thrown down, defeated (Revelation 12:7–9).
Disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, Jude tells us, Michael durst not bring against him a railing judgment, but said: The Lord command thee (Jude 1:9).
